title: Biology revision
goal: Show a structured biology revision map spanning core topic areas and study sub-topics.

rubric.must: Biology Revision is visibly the central root of the map.
Cell Biology, Genetics, Human Physiology, and Ecology visibly branch from the central topic.
Cell Biology and Genetics visibly expand to organelles or transport and DNA or inheritance sub-topics.
Human Physiology and Ecology visibly expand to their named system and ecosystem sub-topics.
Specific revision leaves such as diffusion and osmosis, Punnett squares, vaccination, and natural selection are visible.
The diagram visibly distinguishes root, subject areas, sub-topics, and detailed study leaves.

ideal.notes: Drafted by Codex from the source, the rubric and the mindmap/map exemplar, without seeing the engine's own output.

review.evidence: The map has a clear central “Biology Revision” root, four color-coded subject branches, and readable sub-topic and study-leaf labels. Connections and hierarchy are traceable, with no material overlaps or cropping.

items.evidence: “Biology Revision” is centered in the main root node.
Cell Biology, Genetics, Human Physiology, and Ecology each branch from the central root.
Cell Biology branches to Organelles and Transport; Genetics branches to DNA and genes and Inheritance.
Human Physiology branches to Circulatory system and Immunity; Ecology branches to Ecosystems and Evolution.
The leaves “Diffusion and osmosis,” “Punnett squares,” “Vaccination,” and “Natural selection” are visible.
The central root, colored subject nodes, plain-text sub-topics, and smaller detailed leaves are visually distinguished.
